TurboQuant benchmarking needs repeatable corpus slices so baseline and native runs can be compared without hiding fallback behavior.
This short fixture is intentionally plain ASCII and deterministic. It exists to exercise the bench-only score route, chunking, delta-vs-baseline reporting, and requested-versus-effective cache metadata.
Longer corpora can be added later, but the first checkpoint keeps the dataset local, reviewable, and fast enough to run on development hosts.
